# Inverse

> > Inverse delivers in-depth coverage of entertainment, gaming, science, and technology with a focus on geek culture, Marvel, Star Wars, and innovation.

Inverse is a digital media outlet covering the intersection of pop culture, technology, and science. The site features retrospectives, reviews, breaking news, and analysis spanning the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Star Wars franchises, gaming history, and emerging tech trends.

## Key Topics

- Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU)
- Star Wars & Andor
- Nintendo & Gaming History
- Sci-Fi Movies & TV Shows
- Geek Culture & Pop Culture
- Marvel Movies & Retrospectives
- Entertainment News
- Tech Reviews & Innovation
- Iron Man & Guardians of the Galaxy
- Sony & Lucasfilm
- 15-Year MCU Anniversary
- Post-Credits Scenes
- Casting History
- Virtual Reality & Education

## Core Pages

- [Inverse](https://www.inverse.com): Homepage covering entertainment, gaming, tech, science, and innovation news
- [Apple TV](https://www.inverse.com/apple-tv): Apple TV+ streaming coverage hub for shows and series updates

## Marvel & Superhero Coverage

- [15 Years of Marvel](https://www.inverse.com/15-years-of-marvel): Special issue celebrating MCU's 15th anniversary with retrospectives
- [Why Jason Momoa Is the Future of the DC Cinematic Universe](https://www.inverse.com/article/10120-why-jason-momoa-is-the-future-of-the-dc-cinematic-universe): Jason Momoa's Aquaman role positions DC against Marvel's dominance
- [Mark Ruffalo Says Cate Blanchett May Be the Villain in 'Thor Ragnarok'](https://www.inverse.com/article/10072-mark-ruffalo-says-cate-blanchett-may-be-the-villain-in-thor-ragnarok): Mark Ruffalo reveals Cate Blanchett as Thor: Ragnarok villain
- [Colossus, Angel Dust, Ajax, and All the Other Heroes and Mutants You'll Meet in 'Deadpool'](https://www.inverse.com/article/10087-colossus-angel-dust-ajax-and-all-the-other-heroes-and-mutants-you-ll-meet-in-deadpool): Character guide to Deadpool movie mutants including Colossus and Ajax

## Star Wars & Sci-Fi

- ['Andor' Season 2 Teases Major Growing Pains for the Rebellion: "The Stakes are Higher"](https://www.inverse.com/andor-season-2-d23-footage-description): D23 exclusive footage breakdown of Andor Season 2 with Diego Luna
- [The Most Stunning Time-Travel Movie Of The Year Is A Vision Of Hopeful Sci-Fi](https://www.inverse.com/arco-review-natalie-portman-tiff): Review of Ugo Bienvenu's 'Arco' animated time-travel film from TIFF
- ['Clone Wars' Animator Spyros Tsiounis Gets Back to His Greek Roots](https://www.inverse.com/article/10130-clone-wars-animator-spyros-tsiounis-gets-back-to-his-greek-roots): Spyros Tsiounis discusses Greek-themed short film 'Them Greeks...!'

## Gaming Retrospectives

- [35 Years Ago, Nintendo Released a Cult Classic RPG That Was Ahead of Its Time](https://www.inverse.com/35-years-ago-this-quirky-rpg-redefined-the-genre-forever): Nintendo's 'Mother' RPG 35th anniversary retrospective and legacy analysis
- [Vault Boy's 'Rule of Thumb' Can't Save You From Nuclear Fallout](https://www.inverse.com/article/10099-vault-boy-s-rule-of-thumb-can-t-save-you-from-nuclear-fallout): Debunking Fallout's Vault Boy nuclear safety myth and Cold War science
